mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, triggering market anticipation of rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.3%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth above 100k and UNRATE decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signal labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 100k and UNRATE MoM < -0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, HOUST above 1000 thousand units and RSAFS above 400,000 million dollars signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST>1000 and RSAFS>400000) during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level exceeding 16,000 billion dollars signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 16,000 billion dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO decline exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO MoM < -0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS increase above 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rise exceeding 0.2% month-over-month signal aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS MoM > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.2%).

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE below 5.5%), a declining unemployment rate supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.5%.
